name: Ali Farhadi

affiliations.role: Corporate Vice President of AI, Microsoft Superintelligence

bio: Ali Farhadi is a computer scientist and professor at the University of Washington's Allen School. Farhadi was CEO of the Allen Institute for AI from July 2023 until stepping down in March 2026, and then joined Microsoft's superintelligence group as a corporate vice president. Research areas include computer vision, language and vision, and machine learning.
known_for: Co-author of the YOLO real-time object detection papers
CEO of Ai2 during the OLMo open model releases
Computer vision and visual reasoning research at UW
